title: The Rake s Progress
librettist: W. H. Auden and Chester Kallman based on the eight paintings and engravings 'A Rake's Progress' (1733–1735) of William Hogarth
premiere: Teatro La Fenice, Venice on 11 September 1951

synopsis.text:
Stravinsky's most important operatic work looks back to Mozart musically and has a libretto by W. H. Auden inspired by the engravings of William Hogarth.
